title: Demon Slayer Unveils New Look At Love Hashira Ahead of Her Biggest Fight In Infinity Castle
content: It’s been almost a year since the first installment of the Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle trilogy hit the Japanese theaters. The film was originally released in July 2025 and made its international debut in September of the same year.
author: ComicBook

title: Yoroi-Shinden Samurai Troopers Anime's 2nd Part Unveils Theme Songs, More Cast, July 7 Debut in New Video
content: The staff for Yoroi-Shinden Samurai Troopers , the new sequel anime of the Yoroiden Samurai Troopers series, presented the full promotional video for the anime's second cours (quarter of a year) on Monday. The video announces more cast members, theme song artists, and the July 7 premiere for the next part.
author: ANN

title: KILL BLUE Reveals Recap Trailer, Creator Tadatoshi Fujimaki to Appear at Anime Expo 2026
content: DMM announced that KILL BLUE creator Tadatoshi Fujimaki will attend Anime Expo 2026 for a special panel and official autograph session. The announcement was accompanied by the release of a new recap trailer summarizing the anime’s first seven episodes.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Honoo no Toukyuujo: Dodge Danko' Reveals Additional Cast, Staff, Theme Songs, Main Promo
content: The official website of the Honoo no Toukyuujo: Dodge Danko revealed additional cast, staff, theme songs, and the main promotional video on Monday. The anime, adapting Tetsuhiro Koshita 's sequel team sports manga , will premiere on Tokyo MX, MBS, and BS11 at 11:00 p.m. every Monday, beginning July 6.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Bleach Announces New Release Ahead of Final Season Premiere
content: Bleach is gearing up for the anime’s grand finale later this Summer, but the franchise has some big plans with a new project that’s also going to be hitting around the same time.
author: ComicBook

title: Hunter x Hunter Manga Releases 1st New Volume in 22 Months on July 3
content: Shueisha published chapters 401 to 410 of the manga in its Weekly Shonen Jump magazine from issue 45 of 2024 to issue two of 2025. Togashi underwent surgery and announced that he had drafted the storyboard layouts for two more chapters of the manga in December 2024.
author: ANN

title: 5 Shonen Protagonists Who Redefined What an Anime Hero Can Be
content: Over the years, anime has developed its own identity, and due to the popularity of shonen series, the genre has come to overshadow much of the industry. Shonen anime often follows a familiar formula, from its narrative structure to its protagonists.
author: ComicBook

title: Voice Actor Katsuji Mori Cancels Stage Performance in Reading Event Due to Injury
content: Voice actor Katsuji Mori announced on his X (formerly Twitter ) account on Sunday that he will not perform on stage and will focus on directing the upcoming "Kotoba no Mori" reading performance.
author: ANN
